name: warp-tunnel
title: WarpTunnel
description: Rounded frames rushing toward the viewer, like flying down a tunnel.

accessibility: The effect layer is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events; only children are exposed.
Zooming motion is a strong vestibular trigger: keep `speed` slow and give users a visible pause control.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it on demand (wire it to a visible control if it runs behind reading content).
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows the tunnel as still, nested frames.
